title: MT61328: Microstructure
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Fundamentals : Atomic bonding, Crystal Structure, Crystal imperfections,
Diffusion in Solids, Nucleation and growth,Cold working and annealing, Phase
diagrams, Segregation in castings. Iron - Carbon Alloys : Phase diagram of
iron-cementite alloy system, Isothermal transformations â Austenite to
pearlite, martensite and bainite, Continuous-cooling transformations,
Annealing, Normalizing, Quench hardening and tempering, Grain size effects,
Austempering and martempering, Effect of different elements, Non-heat treatable
low carbon steel, Quench-aging and strain-aging, Hardenable carbon steels.
Microalloyed steels :- Specifiactions, Precipitation and strengthening
mechanisms, Dual-phase steels. Alloy steels :Classification, Effects of
alloying elements, Hardenability, Temper embrittlement, Maraging steels.
Stainless steels : Ferritic, austenitic, Martensitic, Precipitation-hardenable
and duplex stainless steels. Tool steels : Secondary hardening, Hot and cold
work tool steels, High-speed steels, Cemented carbides. Cast irons
Classification, Iron-carbon-silicon system, Gray cast iron, Ductile cast iron,
Malleable cast iron, Abrasion-resistant, Heat-resistant and corrosion-resistant
cast irons, Austempered ductile irons.
